If nobody speaks up, I'm going to nuke about half
the functions in agrad/matrix. The only reason I'm
not doing it now is that I can't figure out why someone
would've put them there in the first place and I don't
want to break something through stupidity on my part.

Marcus -- are these things you were using for
something? I think you're the only other one
who worked on this other than me and Daniel and
we can't figure out what they are for.

- Bob

parts:
I'll go ahead and pass the (git) blame on this. I created matrix.cpp
by moving a bunch of stuff out of matrix.hpp (to speed up compile
times). You can git a better idea of who's truly responsible with the
command line
git blame 4da6ff600a85343de1b2c50f08698fcc097254b1 src/stan/agrad/matrix.hpp
which will tell you who last touched those functions before they were
moved to matrix.cpp.

My guess is that most of these functions are never called anywhere.

Matt
